Finding your food triggers can feel like looking for a needle in a haystack. Bellywise brings your meals, ingredients and symptoms together, helping you spot possible patterns without poring over pages of notes.

A busy day, a homemade meal, a long ingredients label: keeping a useful food diary can take effort. Bellywise makes recording easier, so you can build a fuller picture of what you eat and how you feel.

QUICKER FOOD AND DRINK LOGGING
• Scan a barcode to look up the exact product's published ingredients through Open Food Facts.
• Photograph an ingredients list and select the relevant part of the label.
• Search by brand to find packaged products.
• Type a food or dish, then adjust suggested ingredients to match what you actually ate.
• Group scanned products and individual items into one meal.
• Log a previous meal again, including its ingredients: ideal for leftovers and regular favourites.

Ingredients are separated into individual items you can review, edit or remove. If a product record is missing or incomplete, photograph the label or enter ingredients yourself. Suggested recipes are clearly distinguished from confirmed ingredients.

LOG HOW YOU FEEL
Choose common symptoms or add your own. Record when they began and how severe they felt on a simple 1–5 scale. You can also log positive feelings and confirm symptom-free days, helping your diary capture the good days as well as the difficult ones.

LOOK BEYOND THE MEAL NAME
The same ingredient can appear in many different meals. Bellywise compares ingredients across your diary and explores relevant components such as gluten and lactose, with estimates clearly identified.

See whether a symptom occurred more often or felt more intense after an ingredient was logged. Comparisons consider later the same day and the following day, rather than treating an earlier symptom as the result of a later meal.

EXPLORE THE EVIDENCE
Open a pattern to see charts, dates and the meals behind it. Compare days with and without an ingredient, understand which days were included, and see when ingredients tend to occur together.

Stress and sleep provide extra context and can flag other possible explanations. Clear descriptions help you understand uncertainty and when more records are needed. Your notes remain available for your own review and reports.

MAKE YOUR DIARY WORK FOR YOU
• Set food reminders at times that suit your routine.
• Choose an evening review reminder and optional new-pattern alerts.
• Use the Home Screen widget for shortcuts to log food, drinks or feelings and review your day.
• Learn about ingredients, food intolerance, lactose, gluten and FODMAPs through accessible guides with source links.
• Explore your recorded food-group variety over time.
• Export a readable report to discuss with a healthcare professional, and save or restore a diary backup.
• Get started with a skippable tutorial and an example diary.
